title: Effective object permissions ignore the external write gate, so the console offers New, Import, Edit and Delete on a read-only external object
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Carries item 1 (the doors are offered) of #30334; #30334 keeps item 2 (the refusal message, `domain:ui`, in flight on `claude/project-thread-9t8krp`). Item 3 is a separate card. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets lane and grade.

**Business reason.** An administrator on a table synced from an external database in read-only mode is offered 新建 / 导入 / edit / delete, fills a form, and is refused. No permission set can fix a table that is read-only by design (ADR-0015), so the doors should not be offered.

**Reading** (the #30334 card thread, read-only at `origin/main` `fdad1786`, not yet re-measured by the seat):

- Every console write door (new, import, edit, delete) asks `@object-ui/core` `resolveAffordance`, which reads three things: the `managedBy` bucket (spec `resolveCrudAffordances`), `apiOperations` from `/auth/me/permissions`, and `allowCreate` / `allowEdit` / `allowDelete`.
- All three are folded by `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, whose docblock says it reflects what the server actually enforces. It clamps managed writes and `apiEnabled`, and never reads ADR-0015 Gate 3 (objectql `assertWriteAllowed`: `datasource.external.allowWrites` AND `object.external.writable`).
- So the server refuses the write (403 `EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN`) while its own effective-permission answer says the write is allowed. The console has no door that reads a verdict and ignores it.

**Expected.** The effective permissions served to the console say no create / edit / delete (and no import) on an object whose external write gate is closed, so the console's existing affordance reads hide or disable those doors with no `ui/**` change; declared = enforced.

**Reader.** `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` and its tests (likely `domain:server`); the console needs no change if the served answer is right.

Links: #30334, ADR-0015.
